summary: EUDA Health Holdings Ltd, a BVI-incorporated Singapore-based health services foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K reporting results of its October 30, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting (the US equivalent of a special shareholder meeting). Holders of 2,088,134 of 2,994,325 ordinary shares voted, a 69.74% quorum. All three proposals passed overwhelmingly: dual-class authorized share change creating unlimited Class A and 2,000,000 Class B no-par shares, reclassification of 437,824 shares held by Tan Meng Dong and affiliates into Class B, and adoption of amended and restated memorandum and articles filed with the BVI Registrar effective October 30. No transaction terms; routine governance matter. Watch dual-class control consolidation and dilution implications.
